metadata.description: Measure whether a Claude Code skill earns its context cost

plugins.name: skill-measure
plugins.description: Hermetic measurement harness for Claude Code skills: paired with/without value benchmarks, description-ablation trigger tests, blind grading with an adversarial prosecutor and a pluggable cross-family judge, cost-gated spend, and pre-registration discipline. Wraps a rented execution substrate (promptfoo, version-pinned; native fallback) under a bespoke causal + pre-registration layer.
